summary: NPC one-liners from content: lines by trigger (spotted, hurt, near, idle, or your own), per-speaker and global cooldowns, no immediate repeats, shown as a label over the speaker and announced as BarkSaid for subtitles.
setup: List Barks in Game(systems=[...]) (and HurtBarks with the combat plugin); give speakers a "barker" component with their voice.
Write content/bark/*.json (voice, trigger, lines); emit BarkRequested(speaker=npc, trigger="spotted") from AI; tune config/barks.json.
